items.name: Hvidovre Special 2020
items.information: Denne konkurrence foregår i sammenhæng med FMC 2020. Hvidovre Special 2020 vil slutte lørdag aften, og FMC 2020 vil starte søndag morgen, i samme venue. FMC 2020 er en seperat konkurrence. Hvis du vil deltage i FMC, skal du tilmelde dig FMC 2020 seperat [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2020). Husk, der er ikke den standard 3x3x3 terning til denne konkurrence! Dette er en mere speciel konkurrence, du kan se de andre konkurrencer i Danmark [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=%E2%9C%93&region=Denmark&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). ____ This competition is happening in succession with FMC 2020. Hvidovre Special 2020 will end Saturday evening, and FMC 2020, a seperate competition, will be starting Sunday morning in the same venue. If you want to compete in FMC you must sign up through [this link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2020). Keep in mind, this competition does not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube event!
